author: WPB4
summary: Alpha.1-era research audit (CNA 7a64362e, 2026-08-11) of the Model runtime, glTF import core, GPU packing, skinning and animation, the CNJ toolchain and the glTF conformance apparatus, with a feature table and a critique of CNA's glTF documents. The model deep dives already carry nearly all current substance, and most limitations it lists were fixed by 009d40f5 (all ledger defects, rigid animation, factor-only PBR, topologies, validation, 148-asset corpus, L6/L7). Residue added: the cgltf faults answered on CNA's side, the two BuildSkeleton overloads, and the tests that guard the glTF evidence.

sections.heading: 0. The feature/gltf lane in one paragraph

concepts.section: 0. The feature/gltf lane in one paragraph
concepts.text: The glTF lane of August 2026 was a correctness-remediation lane (plan, normative conformance document, Python fixture generator, committed corpus with SHA-256 manifest, numerical oracles, executable defect ledger), mostly test and documentation commits; its size figures describe that lane only.
concepts.note: Campaign chronology of the audited revision; the current corpus, ladder and ledger are described on the glTF conformance page.

concepts.section: 0. The feature/gltf lane in one paragraph
concepts.text: The lane's four production fixes were sparse index decoding, primitive-mode classification, the glTF node hierarchy as real ModelBones, and the skin coordinate spaces.
concepts.note: At 009d40f5 all original records D1-D8 and the later GLTF-241 are fixed and kept as regression witnesses.

concepts.text: The XNA model runtime was eight small classes of about 1,700 lines plus SkinnedModelEXT.
concepts.note: Line counts of the audited revision; not a current technical fact.

concepts.text: Model owns nothing by value: collections hold raw bone and mesh pointers and a type-erased shared_ptr<void> ownedResources_ set by each loader keeps the graph alive, so a hand-built Model has no automatic owner.
CopyAbsoluteBoneTransformsTo composes bone.Transform times the parent's absolute in one forward pass, correct only because bones are stored parent before child, an invariant Model never checks.
Model::Draw used a static process-wide scratch buffer sharedDrawBoneMatrices_, so two models drawn from different threads shared it.
concepts.note: At 009d40f5 the scratch vector is thread_local and a four-thread test pins it.

concepts.text: Model::Draw rejects an effect without IEffectMatrices, sets World to the parent-bone absolute times world, then draws each mesh; it never installs skinning palettes.
concepts.note: The exception is System::InvalidOperationException at 009d40f5 (was std::runtime_error).

concepts.text: ModelMesh::Draw calls Ensure3DSupported first, silently skips parts with a null effect or a non-positive primitive count, and binds each part's buffers.

ModelMeshPart::setEffectProperty keeps the mesh's ModelEffectCollection consistent by scanning sibling parts before removing an effect (O(parts), not a refcount); parts hold non-owning raw effect and buffer pointers.
Two deliberately separate skeletal systems exist: SkinningData plus AnimationPlayer on Model.Tag, and SkinnedModelEXT for avatars, with an intentionally duplicated SampleTrack helper.
tokens: do not share a runtime graph

concepts.text: Both players validate input (array-size mismatch throws, a parent not before its child throws), wrap loops by floor-mod on raw ticks, interpolate translation and scale linearly and rotation spherically, and search keys linearly.
tokens: linear search for the bracketing key

concepts.text: SkinningData carries a fourth array, SkeletonRootPrefix, composed as world(root) = local * prefix for root bones only, with an empty array read as identity.
Skinning caps: SkinnedEffect and SkinnedPbrEffect MaxBones = 72, four byte blend indices and weights per vertex, at most 255 addressable joints, and one UV channel.
concepts.note: Two UV sets reach PBR layouts at 009d40f5; a skin over 72 joints is refused at import.

concepts.text: Morph targets are CPU-blended and the vertex buffer re-uploaded; normal deltas applied only on strides 32, 52 and 56.
concepts.note: At 009d40f5 normal and tangent offsets come from the canonical stride table, so PBR strides blend normals too.

concepts.text: The glTF importer is a shared library core, CNA::Internal::GltfImport (GltfImportCore), consumed by both the offline converter and the runtime ReadGltfModel.
Parsing is delegated to vendored cgltf 1.15; GltfImportCore.cpp is the single CGLTF_IMPLEMENTATION unit and compiles stb_image/stb_image_write STATIC to avoid colliding with another stb copy.

CNA answers faults of the vendored cgltf on its own side instead of patching the header: indices are decoded by CNA because cgltf's index helper returns 0 without an error channel, byte spans are computed overflow-safely, and tests pin that each answer stays in place.
concepts.note: The audit named the index-helper and span rationale; the page adds the two further proven faults (sparse values stride, signed-normalized clamp) and their witness tests.

concepts.text: .gltf and .glb share one cgltf_parse_file path, and ModelTypeReader lists .cnj before .gltf and .glb so a converted sidecar wins.
cgltf_validate was never called and extensionsRequired/extensionsUsed were never read, so a file requiring an unimplemented extension loaded silently.
concepts.note: At 009d40f5 ValidateGltfEXT runs structural checks and cgltf_validate, and a 21-record registry refuses unclaimed required extensions.

concepts.text: Only asset.version 2.0 was accepted, anything else throwing.
concepts.note: The check is conditional at 009d40f5: it applies when the field is present.

concepts.text: The importer touched about 60 cgltf symbols and none for samplers, cameras, alpha mode or cutoff, double-sidedness or base-colour factor, so those were structurally absent.
concepts.note: At 009d40f5 samplers, alpha state, double-sidedness, base colour and cameras are imported.

concepts.text: BuildSceneGraph flattens the default scene (else the first) parent before child with an explicit stack, inserts a synthetic identity root named Root at index 0, reads local transforms through cgltf_node_transform_local and imports a node reachable twice once.

ConvertGltfMatrix converts glTF's column-major column-vector matrices to XNA row-vector form by copying the affine basis and forcing the last column, correct for the affine transforms glTF allows and silently dropping any projective component.

CollectMeshGroups makes one group per distinct skin plus one unskinned group, excludes nodes unreachable from the selected scene, and falls back to every mesh at the identity root when no scene node references a mesh.
Both loaders build one ModelBone per scene node index for index and keep vertex positions mesh-local, so one mesh instanced by two nodes becomes two ModelMeshes sharing geometry.
A rigid mesh hangs off its instancing node's bone, while a skinned mesh's node bone still exists but the mesh hangs off bone 0, because the joint matrices already cover the mesh node.

BuildSkeleton has a one-argument compatibility overload that passes an empty scene graph and identity mesh-node transform; callers that can build a graph must use the four-argument form, which both loaders do.
concepts.note: By reading, the one-argument form still recovers joint ancestry through the cgltf_node_transform_world fallback (its comment says identity); it omits only the mesh-node cancellation and scene mappings. Test oracles use it for palette order.

concepts.text: Joints are reordered breadth-first into parent-before-child order with an oldToNew map through which JOINTS_0 is remapped at pack time; an unresolvable parent chain throws.

A root joint's parentWorldPrefix is ancestorWorld times Invert(meshNodeWorld); skin.skeleton is not a traversal stop, and a joint under a node outside the default scene falls back to cgltf_node_transform_world.
The prefix is deliberately not folded into bindPoseLocal because an animation clip replacing the root joint's local transform would silently undo it.

unitScale scales translations only, consistently across bind poses, inverse binds, ancestor worlds, positions, morph deltas and animation translations; the runtime path fixes it at 1.0 and only the converter exposes it.
ExtractMesh classified glTF primitive modes 0-6 and rejected every mode except TRIANGLES, throwing for a mode outside 0-6.
concepts.note: At 009d40f5 points and lines keep their topology, loops close and strips and fans convert; only an out-of-range mode is refused.

concepts.text: CNA decodes index accessors itself: it validates scalar unsigned types, computes an overflow-safe span, resolves sparse overrides including a null base view, reads with memcpy, names the offending value in errors, synthesises the implicit range and proves every index below the vertex count.
Index width is chosen only by the packed vertex count (more than 65,535 means 32-bit), never by the source component type, which the preceding bound proof makes safe.
The vertex stride ABI was a seven-entry table (20, 24, 32, 48, 52, 56, 68) selected by one expression, with missing normals, UVs and colour alpha filled by defaults.
tokens: the canonical table has eleven entries and the glTF importer emits ten
concepts.note: At 009d40f5 the canonical table has eleven entries (adds 16, 60, 76, 80), selection is data-driven and missing normals are computed.

concepts.text: The glTF path created no VertexDeclaration: strides 16-32 were rebuilt as typed vertex structs and larger strides uploaded raw, because polymorphic IVertexType inflates sizeof and a reinterpret_cast read fields at wrong offsets, the cause of an invisible-model symptom family.
concepts.note: At 009d40f5 every buffer carries a VertexDeclaration built from the canonical table.

concepts.text: No axis or handedness conversion is performed, correctly, because glTF and XNA are both right-handed, +Y up, -Z forward with a top-left UV origin; only the tangent w sign carries handedness.
tokens: No axis or handedness conversion is applied

concepts.text: Winding is not flipped for negative-determinant node scales, and the tangent generator is angle-weighted Lengyel-style, deliberately not a bit-exact MikkTSpace port.
concepts.note: At 009d40f5 mirrored placements are detected and reported but still not flipped (WP13-i022).

concepts.text: primitiveCount was numIndices / 3 in all three model loaders and ModelMesh::Draw hard-coded TriangleList.
concepts.note: At 009d40f5 each part carries its primitive type through every route and counts follow the topology.

concepts.text: PBR was selected only when a normal or metallic-roughness map existed and MeshOut had no baseColorFactor, alphaMode, alphaCutoff or doubleSided, so a factor-only material lost every property.
concepts.note: Defect D7 is fixed at 009d40f5.

concepts.text: DualTextureEffect receives glTF occlusion only after the image is decoded, RGB-halved and re-encoded, because XNA doubles its second texture (0.5 neutral) while glTF uses 1.0 for full light; the remap is cached separately from the unmodified PBR occlusion map.
Images resolve from buffer views, base64 data URIs and percent-decoded external files; the runtime decodes them in memory and caches them per image for one Load.

Exactly four extensions were handled: KHR_texture_transform (base colour only, baked into one UV), KHR_materials_emissive_strength, KHR_lights_punctual (at most three, all as directional) and optional KHR_draco_mesh_compression.
concepts.note: At 009d40f5 a 21-record registry governs extensions; texture transforms are per map; the three-light directional approximation remains.

concepts.text: KHR_materials_transmission, KHR_materials_variants, sRGB handling, samplers and cameras were entirely absent.
concepts.note: At 009d40f5 transmission is approximated, variants and cameras are kept, samplers map onto XNA state.

concepts.text: A per-map UV-set mismatch was detected but only the converter warned; the runtime computed the flag and discarded it.
concepts.note: At 009d40f5 a third UV set is reported as uv-set-mismatch on both paths.

concepts.text: Skeletal clips resample each bone onto the union of its channel key times (deduplicated at 1e-9) with LINEAR, STEP and real CUBICSPLINE Hermite sampling; channels resolve through the skin's joint map and duration is the largest input time.
Rigid (unskinned) node animation was dropped silently by two mechanisms (clips extracted only for skinned groups, non-joint channels skipped).
concepts.note: Defect D6 is fixed: unskinned models carry rigid clips; the remaining mixed-carrier loss is reported.

concepts.text: Morph-weight animation is a separate skin-independent path that keeps cubic tangents unbaked for lazy Hermite evaluation, taking the channel from the first node that instances the mesh.
Runtime Load<Model> resolves .cnj, then .gltf, then .glb, parses in process and stores SkinningData in Model.Tag; the audited path imported only groups.front().
concepts.note: All groups are imported into one Model at 009d40f5 and compiled .xnb/.cnb tiers come first.

concepts.text: cna_tool_gltf_to_cnj is built unconditionally with no renderer and takes input, output directory, base name and an optional unitScale; per group it writes a version-2 Model .cnj, vertex/index/morph binaries, an optional skeleton, clip documents and extracted textures.
The Model CNJ schema version 2 adds a bones array (name, parent, 16-float local, identity root at 0) and a per-mesh parentBone; version-1 files still load with a fallback bone per mesh.
.skeleton.bin gained an optional third matrix block detected by the remaining byte count so older sidecars still load.
Four routes produced a Model (XNB ModelReader, the only one reading a real VertexDeclaration; CNJ; runtime glTF; .skinnedmodel.json for SkinnedModelEXT).

concepts.text: docs/gltf-conformance.md pins the glTF 2.0 specification to a Khronos commit and SHA-256 with a re-verification recipe; the specification is not vendored or a dependency.
The oracle ladder had seven layers of which five (container, accessors, mesh streams, world positions, byte goldens) were implemented; bound effect parameters and rendered pixels were not.
concepts.note: At 009d40f5 L6 is implemented, L7 is recorded per renderer, and an L0 gate exists.

concepts.text: The committed corpus under tests/assets/gltf is generator-produced and digest-verified; the audited tree had 16 assets and 14 golden pairs.
concepts.note: 148 assets in 744 files at 009d40f5.

concepts.text: tools/gltf_fixtures is a standard-library, deterministic Python generator with --out, --check and --list; CnaTests re-verifies digests so no Python is needed at test time.

concepts.text: Each .expected.json keeps spec-derived expectations apart from CNA's measured currentActual; a known-defect test asserts both that the expectation is unmet and that the divergence is exactly the recorded one, and records move known-failing to partially-remediated to fixed without deletion.

concepts.text: Every glTF fixture is CNA-authored and MS-PL; Khronos sample assets and the validator were not pinned, and an unrelated large .glb outside the repository was unreferenced.
concepts.note: At 009d40f5 the validator is pinned and sample assets are fetched on demand, never committed.

concepts.text: The glTF import suites guard their own evidence: an accessor-decode lock whose production half compares ExtractMesh output with the L2 dump, an oracle-non-interference test, and a cross-check of BuildSceneGraph world matrices against CopyAbsoluteBoneTransformsTo.
GltfToCnjToolTests spawns the real converter binary as a subprocess, located through a compile-time path, and is excluded on Windows, Emscripten, Android and iOS.
Per-file line and test counts of the glTF, model and graphics suites and the lane's commit-trailer totals.

concepts.text: Model::Draw and ModelMesh::Draw had no unit test; the draw path was exercised only by renderer example programs.
concepts.note: At 009d40f5 Draw has unit tests, including the IEffectMatrices rejection and a four-thread draw test.

concepts.text: 3D-pipeline content tests skip with GTEST_SKIP when GraphicsCapability::ThreeD is false, while the pure importer suites are not gated.
tokens: A green STUB run is therefore no evidence for the Model routes

concepts.text: IGraphicsRenderer::Ensure3DSupported defaults to a no-op and is called at the top of every 3D draw route and in ModelMesh::Draw; only a few 2D renderers override it to refuse early, the others refuse deeper.
concepts.note: The audited overrider list included renderers retired since; the page names the current ones.

concepts.text: SupportsCapability defaults to true for most capabilities, so a renderer must opt out; the default-true polarity is a trap.
concepts.note: At 009d40f5 MultiStreamVertexInput, float render targets and CompiledEffects default false; 19 capabilities exist.

concepts.note: Most listed directories are retired renderer families; the current 25 identities and their 2D/3D split are documented on the renderer pages.
